$comment: Cases both editors must judge alike, of the Kotlin a backend action's options and arguments are written in; the format is that of kotlin.json. A Kotlin template expression stands where Datastar is handed a value the code computes, and is never judged as the text the analysis reads in its place.

cases.name: a Kotlin template in an option's value or key is an expression, not judged
cases.source:
import io.github.markusaugust.streamlord.html.*
fun f(mode: String, n: Int, b: Boolean, ct: String, k: String) = elements { div { dataOnClick("@get('/x', {retry: '${mode}', retryInterval: '${n}', openWhenHidden: '${b}', contentType: '${ct}', ${k}: 1, retryMaxCount: '$n'})") } }

cases.name: a Kotlin template in an option's value in a raw string is an expression, not judged
cases.source:
import io.github.markusaugust.streamlord.html.*
fun f(r: String) = elements { div { dataOnClick("""@get('/x', {retry: '${r}'})""") } }

cases.name: a Kotlin template in an action's name or argument is not judged
cases.source:
import io.github.markusaugust.streamlord.html.*
fun f(a: String) = elements { div { dataOnClick("@${a}('/x'); @get${a}('/x'); @peek('${a}'); @get('${a}'); @setAll(1, {${a}: /x/, include: '${a}'})") } }

cases.name: a Kotlin template in an HTML string's action is not judged
